page_title: SAL 2-1 LAZ | Salernitana v Lazio 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Alessandro Prontera has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is penalised for a foul. Alessandro Prontera had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+4' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) is the one who receives a yellow card.
90+4' Matias Vecino (Lazio) picks up a yellow card.
90+2' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' A corner kick by Lazio is thwarted by the well prepared Benoit Costil (Salernitana).
89' Federico Fazio (Salernitana) gets a yellow card.
87' Filippo Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Lorenzo Pirola is replaced by Dylan Bronn (Salernitana).
86' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
84' The whistle blows and Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) is booked for an infringement.
81' The substitution has been made. Matias Vecino (Lazio) has replaced Danilo Cataldi.
80' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
79' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) gets a yellow card.
78' Free kick. Lazio will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
77' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) brings an opponent down and Alessandro Prontera interrupts the game. Lazio are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
76' Lazio are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) for Grigoris Kastanos.
72' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) has an effort from distance but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
71' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

71' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
69' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Felipe Anderson and he is replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
69' The substitution is prepared. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ciro Immobile.

66' 2 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top of the net. Ivan Provedel just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:1.
66' Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle and signals a foul after Daichi Kamada (Lazio) brought his opponent down. Salernitana win a free kick.
65' Referee Alessandro Prontera halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Filippo Inzaghi, then shows him a yellow.
62' Substitution. Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Manuel Lazzari walks off.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pedro (Lazio) is coming onto the pitch as Mattia Zaccagni cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' Filippo Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Flavius Daniliuc will be replaced by Federico Fazio (Salernitana).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Emil Bohinen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
60' Felipe Anderson rounds off a good move with a layoff to Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
59' Ivan Provedel pulls off a great save to deny Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
55' 1 - 1 Goal! 1:1. Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
53' The booking goes to Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana).

49' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
46' Filippo Inzaghi makes a half-time substitution. Matteo Lovato comes on in place of Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+2' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
45+1' Adam Marusic (Lazio) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Alessandro Prontera pulls out a yellow card.
43' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ciro Immobile (Lazio) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Benoit Costil no chance!
43' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
43' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Lazio!
40' Referee Alessandro Prontera makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
40' PENALTY APPEAL after Ciro Immobile (Lazio) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
39' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
37' A lofted cross from Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Now Salernitana have a corner.
35' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
35' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Lazio win a corner.
33' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
32' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
32' Booking. Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) receives a caution from the referee.
30' Mario Gila (Lazio) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
30' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lazio.
30' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Lazio get a corner.
27' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

27' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
25' Emil Bohinen (Salernitana) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
24' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) works the corner short.
23' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Provedel intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Salernitana will have a chance to score from a corner.
22' Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
21' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' A cross by Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
15' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
11' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alessandro Prontera stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
6' Wonderful movement by Lazio. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
4' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
2' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) tries to find Felipe Anderson, but he puts too much power on the pass.
1' The first half has just begun.
Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) tries to find Felipe Anderson, but he puts too much power on the pass.
The players are out at last! Salernitana will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alessandro Prontera.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
